rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the feeling of contentment after a need or desire is fulfilled.

example.english: Finishing this report gives me real satisfaction.
example.traditional: 做完呢份報告，我真係有滿足感。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 jau5 mun5 zuk1 gam2

rows.note: Use the noun sense for objective fulfillment, or for something that gives someone deep satisfaction, as in 一大滿足.

example.english: Saving enough money to buy a flat was a great satisfaction for me.
example.traditional: 儲夠錢買到間屋，對我嚟講係一大滿足。
example.jyutping: cyu5 gau3 cin2 maai5 dou2 gaan1 uk1 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 daai6 mun5 zuk1

rows.note: Use this when the source of satisfaction is an activity or experience that is enjoyable.

example.english: The satisfaction of building models yourself is seeing them slowly take shape.
example.traditional: 自己整模型嘅樂趣，就係慢慢砌出嚟。
example.jyutping: zi6 gei2 zing2 mou4 jing4 ge3 lok6 ceoi3 zau6 hai6 maan6 maan6 cai3 ceot1 lei4
